components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:5px;font:500 13px/1.4 'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#081728)}.ds-input{font:400 13.5px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#081728);background:var(--surface,#fff);border:1px solid var(--border,#dbe2eb);border-radius:7px;padding:8px 11px;outline:none;transition:border-color .12s ease,box-shadow .12s ease}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--ink-3,#59677b)}.ds-input:hover{border-color:var(--ink-3,#59677b)}.ds-input:focus{border-color:var(--accent,#0858f8);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent,#0858f8) 16%,transparent)}

components.name: Selected Attention Record
components.description: An ordered finding whose selected state hands off directly to evidence.
components.css: .ds-record{position:relative;width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:28px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:10px;align-items:start;padding:13px 14px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-2,#e8edf3);background:var(--accent-soft,#eaf1ff);color:var(--ink,#081728);font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-record:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:2px;background:var(--accent,#0858f8)}.ds-record-sev{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--warn,#a66b00);color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.ds-record strong{display:block;font-size:13px;line-height:1.35}.ds-record small{display:block;margin-top:3px;color:var(--ink-2,#46546c);font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.4}.ds-record-meta{color:var(--ink-3,#59677b);font:10px/1.5 'IBM Plex Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;text-align:right}.ds-record:hover{background:var(--accent-soft,#eaf1ff)}.ds-record:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#0858f8);outline-offset:-2px}

narrative.overview:
CorpIT is a live operational ledger, not a decorative dashboard. A midnight navigation rail anchors a cool-frost workspace where precise rules, compact records, and restrained status color make the current condition easy to scan. The interface feels calm, factual, and densely useful without becoming visually heavy.

The system moves from verdict to evidence to responsible action. Cobalt marks selection and action; amber and red are reserved for conditions that require attention; mono metadata provides timestamps, counts, and machine evidence. Surfaces remain mostly flat so hierarchy comes from placement, tonal shifts, and etched dividers.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight shell against a bright, cool workspace.
Flat, rule-defined panels with restrained corners.
Practical sans hierarchy paired with compact mono metadata.
Ordered records that preserve context while revealing evidence and next steps.
Status is always expressed with text or structure as well as color.

rules.name: The One Action Ink Rule
rules.body: Cobalt owns navigation selection, primary action, links, and focus; do not introduce a competing accent.

rules.name: The Status Has Words Rule
rules.body: Healthy, warning, critical, and unknown conditions always carry a label, symbol, or explanatory copy in addition to color.

rules.name: The Honest Unknown Rule
rules.body: Missing or stale evidence uses muted or explicit unavailable language; it never inherits healthy green.

rules.name: The Evidence Face Rule
rules.body: Use mono for values an operator may compare, copy, or audit; use sans for interpretation and action.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Establish importance with weight, contrast, and grouping before increasing size.

rules.name: The Preserved Context Rule
rules.body: Selection, evidence, and the next action remain visually connected; do not send routine triage into a detached card grid.

rules.name: The Flat Registry Rule
rules.body: Persistent operational surfaces use rules and tonal layers, never floating card shadows.

rules.name: The Restrained Corner Rule
rules.body: Radius indicates component scale; do not soften the console into oversized pills or bubbly cards.

dos: Do lead with the most consequential verified condition and keep its evidence and next safe action adjacent.
Do use one-pixel rules and tonal fields to create structure in persistent surfaces.
Do preserve the sans/mono division between explanation and auditable facts.
Do show stale, failed, loading, and unavailable states explicitly.
Do keep desktop density high while reflowing all controls and facts for narrow viewports.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glass effects, neon color, illustrations, or promotional imagery into the operational shell.
Don't turn the registry into a generic mosaic of independently floating cards.
Don't use shadow as routine separation or introduce hard offset shadows.
Don't use color alone to communicate status or render unavailable evidence as a healthy zero.
Don't add a second accent color or use cobalt as broad decoration.
